name: Montana DLI Construction Contractor Registration Search

agency.name: Montana Department of Labor and Industry

updateFrequency: unknown; verify against the official contractor registration search before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Montana Construction Contractor Registration and Independent Contractor Exemption Certificate records exposed by DLI search paths
Future Montana Construction Contractor License Program records after the announced January 1, 2026 transition where exposed by official DLI services
knownExclusions: Construction Contractor Registration is primarily tied to workers compensation compliance and is not the same as a trade competency license or endorsement for every construction activity.
Montana DLI professional and occupational licenses are represented separately by us.mt.dli.professional_licenses.
Montana DEQ asbestos contractor and consultant publication is represented separately by us.mt.deq.asbestos_contractors.
Local permits, business registrations, utility approvals, and non-DLI authorizations may require separate official sources.
Workers compensation coverage and exemption details need source-specific interpretation before being normalized as compliance facts.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Prefer stable official search or export options before any automation.
publicRecordsNotes: Official DLI registration-search metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that a license, registration, exemption, or local authorization does not exist elsewhere.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: The official DLI page links interactive contractor-registration and exemption-certificate searches; no stable bulk file or API was documented.
researchNotes: The source is contractor-specific but combines Construction Contractor Registration and Independent Contractor Exemption Certificate concepts that must remain distinct from trade licensing and workers compensation coverage. DLI states that the program will transition to a Construction Contractor License Program beginning January 1, 2026 while contractors continue using the current process until the new portal is ready.
maintainerNotes: Keep CCR, ICEC, professional licenses, and workers compensation concepts separate until their source semantics are reviewed.

researchEvidence.note: Official DLI construction contractor registration page reviewed; it states all construction contractors with employees must register, defines construction contractor by reference to work that adds to or takes away from real-property improvements, and announces the January 1, 2026 transition to a Construction Contractor License Program.
Official Montana Contractor page reviewed; it identifies DLI units responsible for Independent Contractor Exemption Certificates and Construction Contractor Registration.
Official DLI search path reviewed as the current interactive registration and exemption-certificate lookup.

blocker.summary: The contractor-registration lookup is interactive and has no documented stable bulk or API contract suitable for an offline-tested adapter.
